fields.text: NFKC, strip zero-width chars, collapse whitespace, strip known labels
fields.vin: extract a 17-char VIN candidate, uppercase, OCR O/I/Q -> 0/1/0
fields.plate_no: strip punctuation/spaces and extract Chinese plate shapes
fields.id_number: resident ID with valid birth date, or 18-char social credit code with letters
fields.passengers: Arabic or simple Chinese numerals; plus expressions are summed
fields.manufacturer: drop contact/phone/testing/power noise; keep company-like names
fields.aliases: move known legacy aliases to canonical keys, then remove aliases and dl_* keys
